qt: to the Commission Asger Christensen (Renew) Subject:

Security of food supply is essential for Europe’s resilience and should therefore be regarded as part of the EU’s critical infrastructure. Given the Commission’s focus on food production and the increasing cyberthreats to European supply chains, would it please answer the following questions: 1.

In the light of the Commissioner’s speech at the Munich Security Conference on 26 February 2026 and the Commission’s livestock strategy of 7 July 2026, can the Commission now confirm that security of food supply is regarded as part of the EU’s critical infrastructure?

What will the Commission do to prevent cyberattacks on the European food supply chain and thereby safeguard security of food supply, bearing in mind in particular the cyberattacks carried out on French and Belgian supermarket chains?
In this context, will the Commission be discussing the security of food supply with the Member States, which play a crucial role in protecting this part of the EU’s critical infrastructure?
